explanation: Carry a one from the least significant digit. Every trailing nine becomes zero; increment the first smaller digit, or prepend one when the carry passes the first digit.
spaceComplexity: O(n) space for the returned copy; O(1) other auxiliary space.
attribution: Original C# implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract.
correctness: The carry is one until it reaches a digit below nine. Replacing each trailing nine by zero is exactly decimal carry propagation. Incrementing the first remaining digit completes the sum; if none remains, a leading one is necessary.
walkthrough: For [7,9,9], turn the last 9 into 0 and carry, turn the next 9 into 0 and carry, then increment 7 to 8. Return [8,0,0].
edgeCases: An all-nine input grows by one digit.
The returned copy leaves the supplied input list unchanged.
